title: Home FAQ
summary: Fills slot.home.faq on the home page: contact CTA plus an accordion of { q, a } items. Disable the plugin to hide the block. There is no FAQ admin CRUD and no FAQ table.

blocks.title: Slot only
blocks.text: front/index.tsx sets slots[CORE_FRONT_SLOTS.homeFaq] to <ContactFaq />. PluginSlot on the home page renders it. The block is not mounted on /contact.

items.description: Link to localized /contact using t.contact.eyebrow, title, sub, pageCta

blocks.caption: front/index.tsx

blocks.title: Not a database
blocks.text: Entries are i18n. English lives in the kernel: kernel/front/src/assets/i18n/strings/en/faq.ts. ContactFaq maps t.faq.items. There is no Configure form, no admin list, and no plugin_* table.

items.description: Array of { q: string, a: string }. Type FaqStrings in kernel/front/src/assets/i18n/types/faq.ts

blocks.caption: Shape of an entry

blocks.text: The second item (index 1) appends a link to /sizes (t.guide.title) inside the answer. Other items render item.a as text.

items: English default: edit kernel/front/src/assets/i18n/strings/en/faq.ts. That is a kernel change, not a plugin settings form.
French overlay: home-faq-locale-fr ships front/catalog.ts with catalog.faq (same { title, items } shape). assembleDictionary merges it when lang is fr and the complement is enabled.
Different FAQ product: replace slot.home.faq with your own component and your own data. Do not ALTER kernel tables. Import CORE_FRONT_SLOTS from frontSlots.ts.

blocks.caption: French complement

blocks.title: No contact opening
blocks.text: Replacing this slot changes the home teaser only. The guest form and account chat on /contact are kernel. See Contact.
